title: Suv sinovi bilan chiqarib tashlangan
intro: Qadimgi yozuvlar yilnomalarida hikoyasi dramatik mo''jiza yoki momaqaldiroqli vahiy bilan emas, balki oddiy, ammo chuqur imon sinovi bilan boshlanadigan qiziqarli shaxs mavjud. Bir xalq chorrahada turib, ilohiy rahbarlikni izlardi. Sodir bo'lgan voqea shunchalik aqlli sinov ediki, ular orasida haqiqiy imonlilarni ochib berdi. Ortda qolgan izlardan bu sirni ochib bera olasizmi?
clues: Men odamlar hayratga soladigan nasldan kelib chiqqanman va Alloh meni ular tushuna olmaydigan muqaddas maqsad uchun tanladi.
Tanamda boshqalarda yo'q bo'lgan o'ziga xoslik belgisi bor edi, bu meni xalqim orasida ajralib turishimga sabab bo'ldi.
Daryo sinov deb e'lon qilinganida, ko'pchilik orqaga qaytdi - lekin men Allohning va'dasiga sobit ishonch bilan oldinga intildim.
Menga hech qachon taqiqlangan suvdan ichmaslik buyurilgan edi, ammo lablarimdan bir tomchi ham oqib tushdi — bu gunoh qalbimni abadiy qiynab kelgan.
Alloh menga bir kun kelib kuchli dushmanni o'ldirgani uchun afsonaga aylanadigan yosh cho'pon bilan uchrashishni taqdir qildi.
Qo'shinlar to'qnashganda, men dushman qo'lidan emas, balki daryo bo'yidagi itoatsizligim uchun jazo sifatida ilohiy farmon bilan yiqildim.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
